data.description:
## Observation
The `sweep (windows)` jobs of runs 44487190183 (job 135433617476) and 44503581058 (job 135490319213, main at 92d3f373e2c) fail both cases of `tests/unit/test_git_ssh_output_encoding.py::test_run_git_encodes_str_stdin_as_utf8` (`[subprocess-run]` and `[process-group]`). The test and the product change it covers were added by 04e175d70eb (livid-painful-mosquito, closed). `gitutil.run_git(repo, 'hash-object', '--stdin', input_data='café ✓\n')` returned `550e37cbee00c5f27e69148954b33e5b7ddb57f0`. The expected value, from bytes written directly, is `6b2b281e1146f9673f218f9c76042db37be95d03`.

## Root cause (confirmed by hash)
`550e37cb…` is the git blob hash of `café ✓\r\n`, and `6b2b281e…` is the hash of `café ✓\n` (both computed locally with sha1 over `blob <len>\0<bytes>`). In text mode, `subprocess` wraps the child's stdin in an `io.TextIOWrapper` with default newline handling, which writes every `\n` as `os.linesep` (`\r\n` on Windows). So on Windows, every `run_git` call that passes a `str` to stdin in text mode sends CRLF to git. That changes object hashes for `hash-object`/`mktree`/`commit-tree`-style input, and it changes any newline-delimited stdin protocol. The UTF-8 encoding added by 04e175d70eb is correct; this is a separate newline defect that the new test exposed.

## Approach
In text mode, encode `str` stdin to UTF-8 bytes in `run_git` and write it in binary mode, while still decoding stdout/stderr as UTF-8 text. That keeps the `text=True` return contract and stops newline translation. Check sibling helpers that pass `str` stdin in text mode (sshsig, other `subprocess.run(..., input=str, text=True)` sites under src/rebar) for the same defect.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `run_git` sends `str` stdin to git byte-for-byte as UTF-8, with no newline translation, on every platform.
- [ ] A regression test that does not need Windows fails on the pre-fix code (for example by asserting the bytes reaching the child).
- [ ] Both `test_run_git_encodes_str_stdin_as_utf8` cases pass in a `sweep (windows)` run on main after the fix (run id recorded in a comment).
data.title: run_git text-mode stdin turns \n into \r\n on Windows
